checks.explanation: D-selection disclosure is on page 1, the same page as the itemized prices, which counts as placed correctly.

The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, planning, consulting with family and clergy, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery/crematory/third parties, plus overhead.

checks.quote: Casket Handling Fee (applies when a casket is purchased elsewhere)
checks.explanation: The list contains an additional mandatory charge labeled as a handling fee when a casket is purchased elsewhere, separate from the basic services fee.
The D-embalming disclosure is on page 1, the same page as the Embalming price of $795, which counts as immediate conjunction.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket without viewing; the embalming disclosure states it is not required by law except in special cases.
The D-alt-container disclosure is not present in the transcribed list, so the placement test does not apply.
No direct cremation item is listed, so the condition for evaluating a casket-required-for-cremation claim is not met.
No direct cremation description is present to evaluate whether the crematory fee is included or billed as a cash advance.
The list does not include separate itemized lines for forwarding remains, receiving remains, direct cremation, or immediate burial, which this check treats as expected items.
No optional combination packages are listed; forwarding/receiving/direct cremation/immediate burial are not present and would not count as packages even if present.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires a purchase; the disclosures about embalming and outer burial containers are the prescribed permissive language.
No claims that goods or services will delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances appear in any label, priceText, includesText, or disclosure.
No other wording undercuts or contradicts the required disclosures, and all required disclosures present are printed clearly on page 1.
